superseded before QCAI Stage 1: stolen-key design flaw. The old vault let a thief veto every guardian recovery forever and the guardians could not freeze it. The new PocketVault adds guardianFreeze + unanimous recovery (constructor now takes freezePeriod and unanimousDelay); the factory (immutable implementation) and the router (immutable factory) had to be redeployed with it. PocketDrop and DropPool do not depend on the vault and are unchanged. Live results of this deployment are kept in git history.
